svg.title: Planned food allergen analysis workflow
svg.desc: A required ingredient-list photo goes through a shared OCR process. Local analysis structures ingredients and passes them to a local LLM. Cloud analysis submits OCR text to either an LLM for findings and supporting ingredients or a Decisions model for per-allergen scores and threshold flags. An optional front-of-package photo adds a food-type allergen comparison before the report.

text.tspan: Planned architecture · Ingredient-list analysis with an optional food-type cross-check
Check each allergen separately. Cloud analysis uses either the LLM or Decisions model.
Identify the food type; use model knowledge
Add a reminder for common allergens
not identified in the label analysis
Show ingredients, allergen findings and reminders
Include model scores and uncertainty when available
Planned workflow · Model scores and common-allergen estimates do not confirm an ingredient is present.
